0.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRELICWEAPON025NOTETALK_00170_GJUSANA_000_000
0.description: The Trials of the Braves is a nine-volume work of literature which tells of the heroic feats of the Zodiac Braves.

1.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRELICWEAPON025NOTETALK_00170_GJUSANA_000_001
1.description: As I mentioned earlier, I'm willing to part with each book for the discounted price of 100 <hex:023111FF054974656D04FF06E380803238030203>.

2.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRELICWEAPON025NOTETALK_00170_SYSTEM_000_010
2.description: By defeating all the foes listed within a book of the Trials of the Braves, your relic weapon atma will gain in attributes.

3.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRELICWEAPON025NOTETALK_00170_SYSTEM_000_011
3.description: Distinct sets of Trials of the Braves exist for each relic. A set is comprised of nine books, of which only four are available for exchange at first.

4.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRELICWEAPON025NOTETALK_00170_SYSTEM_000_012
4.description: A paladin's set comprises seven books for Curtana, and two for the Holy Shield. Only six of these are available for exchange at first.

5.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRELICWEAPON025NOTETALK_00170_SYSTEM_000_013
5.description: Each book can be purchased from G'jusana. Please note, however, that you can possess only one at any given time.

6.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRELICWEAPON025NOTETALK_00170_SYSTEM_000_014
6.description: You must complete all of the objectives in a book before you may purchase another.

7.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRELICWEAPON025NOTETALK_00170_SYSTEM_000_015
7.description: Alternately, you may also dispose of it by speaking with G'jusana, or via the Key Items menu.

8.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRELICWEAPON025NOTETALK_00170_SYSTEM_000_016
8.description: This concludes the explanation of the enhancement process. May your relic drink deep of the souls of your enemies!
